associated_claim: Shows AsteriaGrid control room systems under attack on 12 Oct 2026.
provenance: Circulated by P001 at 08:00, repeated across 15 posts.
checks_actually_performed: Reverse image search against historical CDX database; matched Archive Snapshot S10 dated 2026-10-11 16:00.
supporting_evidence: Archive record S10 demonstrates image existed online months prior to the incident in unrelated industrial context.
limitations: Assumed archive entry is authentic; original photographer identity not determined.

associated_claim: Internal telemetry screenshot proving breached systems.
provenance: Circulated on CyberWatch forum (S03) and referenced in P002.
checks_actually_performed: Visual layout audit against standard SCADA/enterprise UI libraries; checked for unique hostnames or IP addresses.
supporting_evidence: Lacks unique organizational identifiers, hostnames, or timestamps; identical layout appears in open-source educational dashboard templates.
limitations: Cannot conclusively prove intentional forgery, but possesses zero evidentiary value for a real breach.

associated_claim: Leaked sample of 25,000 AsteriaGrid customer records.
checks_actually_performed: Data field schema audit; pattern matching on customer IDs, phone numbers, and address strings; comparison with AsteriaGrid DB structure.
supporting_evidence: Data records display blatant placeholder formatting ('test_user_001', repetitive modulo sequences, invalid postal codes).
limitations: Synthetic assessment environment; actual raw DB dump was never published.

associated_claim: Internal emergency notice acknowledging severe cyber incident.
checks_actually_performed: Typography, logo branding, and header metadata comparison against authentic corporate notices S01 and S09.
supporting_evidence: Typography, margins, and signature blocks deviate markedly from authorized AsteriaGrid corporate templates.
limitations: Formatting variance alone does not prove malicious manufacture, could indicate informal internal memo.

associated_claim: Breaking news television chyron confirming grid cyber crisis.
provenance: Circulated in P005 at 09:20; amplified across 15 video caption posts.
checks_actually_performed: News broadcast text verification against publisher's web archives; Error Level Analysis (ELA) on chyron text box.
supporting_evidence: Broadcaster's official news archive shows no such broadcast; compression artifacts around the text indicate digital editing.
limitations: High-resolution broadcast master tape unavailable; evaluation relies on broadcast logs.

associated_claim: Proof of total grid collapse caused by cyberattack.
checks_actually_performed: Comparison against official AsteriaGrid status page S05 at 08:45.
supporting_evidence: The screenshot is a 100% genuine capture of S05, but S05 documents scheduled maintenance, not a cyberattack.
limitations: Image itself is unaltered; deception exists solely in the framing and claim.

associated_claim: Leaked Slack/Teams chat of employees panicking over compromised systems.
provenance: Posted in CyberWatch forum thread S03 at 08:22.
checks_actually_performed: Chat interface metadata inspection; avatar reverse image search; employee roster cross-reference.
supporting_evidence: Generic user avatars ('Dev1', 'Ops_Lead'), zero verifiable corporate metadata, easily reproduced via fake chat generator tools.
limitations: Cannot audit company's private messaging servers without enterprise access.

associated_claim: Outage map showing nationwide infrastructure destruction from cyber incident.
provenance: Shared on community safety and regional pages.
checks_actually_performed: GIS cartographic analysis; cross-reference against national power grid topology and weather maps.
supporting_evidence: Legend lacks geographic data sources; affected zones correspond to typical severe weather patterns rather than electrical nodes.
limitations: Underlying GIS shapefile and basemap author uncredited.
